insights.title: High Frequency of Refresh Calls
insights.description: The endpoint POST /sfdemosite130/nml510_refresh_control.xml was called 52 times in a single test, indicating potential inefficiencies.
insights.recommendation: Investigate the necessity of multiple refresh calls and consider optimizing the workflow.

insights.title: UI Actions Correlate with API Calls
insights.description: User actions such as logging in and generating reports directly trigger corresponding API calls, indicating a clear relationship.
insights.recommendation: Document the UI-API interactions for better understanding of user workflows.

executiveSummary: • All tests executed successfully with no errors reported.
• The highest latency observed was 1770ms during the 'Login and Logout' test.
• The 'NML510 - Trial Balance Report' test involved 52 calls to refresh control endpoints.
• User authentication processes are consistently followed across all workflows.
• High frequency of refresh calls may indicate inefficiencies in report generation.
• No failed endpoints were detected, suggesting stable API performance.
• Further analysis of refresh call patterns could enhance system efficiency.
• Overall, the system appears to support essential financial reporting functions effectively.
